embedded_rust_test_compile_exception.decision: Accept this START-only compile failure under an endpoint-specific rule. The matching END adds SearcherBuilder.max_matches and compiles successfully.

failure_reproduction_policy.decision: Reproduce only the six observed cargo-101 START endpoints.
